name: 90029 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90029 (Los Angeles) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90029 (Los Angeles) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90029 (Los Angeles) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
